title: ModelPackage
description: Provider-neutral descriptor for a developer-supplied/custom local model made available to an IndeRun local-model provider family (for example, the ONNX Runtime family). It describes model identity, format, task support, source, files, integrity, licensing, and resource expectations. It is bootstrap/configuration metadata resolved before execution; it is not part of the public TaskRequest/TaskResult surface, and it must not carry raw secrets.

id.description: Stable application-scoped identifier for the model package.

version.description: Optional application-defined version for the model package, used for cache invalidation and compatibility checks.

format.description: Model packaging format the target runtime family must understand. 'onnx' is a plain ONNX graph, 'ort' is an ONNX Runtime optimized/mobile format, 'genai' is an ONNX Runtime GenAI model package, 'coreai' is an Apple Core AI .aimodel asset (iOS/macOS 27+).

variant.description: Optional concrete artifact variant of this logical model (for example 'onnx-int8', 'coreai-fp16'). 'id' names the model, 'variant' the bytes.

tasks.description: IndeRun task kinds this model package can serve (for example 'text_to_text'). Used by dynamic capability checks and route matching.

runtime.description: Optional runtime compatibility expectations. Fields are advisory hints for capability checks; the provider adapter owns exact enforcement.

minOpset.description: Minimum ONNX opset version the model requires, where known.

minRuntimeVersion.description: Minimum runtime package version required to load the model, where known.

platforms.description: Platforms the package is expected to run on (for example 'web', 'android', 'apple'). Absence means unconstrained.

minOsVersion.description: Minimum platform OS version the package needs, where known (for example '27.0' for a Core AI asset). Applies to every platform listed in `platforms`; split packages whose platforms need different OS floors.

files.description: Files that make up the model package, expressed as source-relative names/paths. The provider adapter and model source resolve these to concrete bytes per platform.

required.description: Files that must be present for the package to load (for example the model graph).

tokenizer.description: Optional tokenizer file, where the model requires one.

config.description: Optional model/generation config file, where the model requires one.

external.description: Optional external data files referenced by the model graph (for example ONNX external weights).

integrity.description: Optional integrity metadata used to validate resolved files before load.

checksums.description: Map of file name to expected checksum (for example 'sha256:...'). Absence means integrity is not verified by IndeRun.

license.description: Optional license/source metadata for the model, for developer transparency. Free-form.

spdx.description: SPDX license identifier where known (for example 'Apache-2.0').

url.description: License or model card URL where available.

source.description: Where the model files are obtained from. Availability of each source type is platform-dependent; see the ONNX Runtime provider-family specification for the per-platform support matrix.

sourceType.description: Discriminator for how the host makes model files available. 'registry' is a web repository/registry reference (for example a Hugging Face-style repo), 'bundled' is an app asset/resource, 'programmatic' is supplied directly by application code, 'filesystem' is a local path where the platform allows it, 'app_managed' is an app-managed cache/storage location, 'remote' is a host-managed download.

ref.description: Optional source-specific reference (for example a registry repo id or a bundled asset base path). Interpretation depends on 'sourceType'. Must not contain credentials: URL userinfo (for example 'https://user:pass@host/...') is rejected, and credentials must be supplied via authContextRef instead.

limits.description: Optional known resource expectations, used by capability checks to reject on constrained devices before load.

diskBytes.description: Approximate on-disk size of the resolved package, where known.

memBytes.description: Approximate peak memory required to run the model, where known.

speech.title: SpeechModelPackage
speech.description: What a text_to_speech model package adds: the pipeline that turns text into PCM, the graphs it runs, its text frontend and the voices it offers. Required when 'tasks' contains 'text_to_speech'.

pipeline.description: The text-to-PCM recipe the provider runs for this package: which graphs in which order, with which text frontend. A provider refuses a value it does not implement.
pipeline.$comment: Known values: 'articulino', 'supertonic'. Later: 'kokoro', 'piper', 'pocket_tts'. Open on purpose: a new model family must not force a schema and codegen change.

sampleRate.description: Sample rate of the PCM the pipeline produces, in Hz.

channels.description: Channels of the PCM the pipeline produces. Absent means 1.

graphs.description: Role to file. Roles are defined by the pipeline (for example 'text', 'dit_step', 'decoder'). For a 'coreai' package a value is either the .aimodel file, whose inference function is then named after the role, or `<file>#<function>` when the function name differs.

frontend.title: SpeechFrontend
frontend.description: How text becomes model input. 'grapheme' pipelines read letters; 'phoneme' pipelines need a grapheme-to-phoneme step whose assets are listed here.

assets.description: Role to file for the frontend's own assets (tokenizer, lexicon, G2P graph).

voices.description: The voices this package offers, one entry per selectable voice. Each is listed through capabilities as a ProviderVoice.

id.description: Identifies the voice within the package and, through the provider, as speech.voice.id. Unique within the package.

name.description: Label for showing the voice to a person.

locales.description: Hyphenated BCP 47 tags the voice speaks (for example 'de-DE', not 'de_DE'); the first is its primary locale.

file.description: The voice asset (style vector or speaker embedding), relative to the package. Absent when the voice is built into the graphs and selected by the pipeline (for example a speaker index). No speaker encoder runs on the device.

assetLicense.title: AssetLicense
assetLicense.description: Licence of one asset inside a package (a voice, a frontend), where it differs from the package's own.

url.description: License or model card URL where available.
